title: Causal learning and causal theories
summary: Causal structure and causal strength as inference problems; causal power; blocking and backward blocking; intervention versus observation; causal theories as priors over causal models; the blicket detector.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is OCW lectures 22–24 (Causal Learning; Causal Theories 1–2) and the web book's dependence chapters together with its 'Estimating Causal Power' example.

preparation.description: Read OCW lectures 22 (Causal Learning), 23 and 24 (Causal Theories 1–2).

Re-read the web book's Causal and statistical dependence and Conditional dependence chapters (blickets and blocking) and the 'Example: Estimating Causal Power' subsection of Learning as conditional inference. Reference-only.
